name: Orison Synthform Adaptive Street Full Kit
description:
Engineered for synthetic body proportions — elongated limb ratios, non-standard joint placement, torso geometries outside human norms. The longline wrap-vest is modular, fastening at custom anchor points rather than standard button lines, in raw-edge indigo canvas with exposed copper stitch. Leg wraps replace trousers: adjustable banded panels in dark olive stretch-tech that conform to any joint configuration. Foot coverings are open-toe wrap sandals with adjustable tension cord, accommodating non-standard foot geometry.

The upper layer is a wide asymmetric drape top in natural-dye rust linen-analog, open-shouldered, with no armhole constraints. No garment in the set assumes bilateral symmetry. Everything is closure-adjustable.
functionality: Fully modular anchor-point closures accommodate non-standard body geometry, adjustable banded leg panels for non-human joint configuration, open asymmetric upper with no armhole constraint, tension-cord footwear for variable foot structure.
what_it_says: This synthetic dresses for a body that has never been catered to — and found a way to look good anyway.
story_hooks: The copper stitch pattern on the vest is a coded synthetic solidarity sigil — wearing it in the wrong neighborhood has consequences.
The stretch-tech banded panels use a material only produced in one Tier-4 lab; Orison shouldn't have access to it.
A Spire fashion house sent a scout to photograph the wearer — they want to 'adapt' the design for human bodies without credit or compensation.

physical_description.visual_profile: Avant-garde modular ensemble designed for non-human body architectures. Elongated silhouette with deliberately asymmetrical draping and unconventional proportions. Presents as fluid, adaptive, and deliberately post-human in aesthetic. Silhouette breaks traditional garment conventions entirely—no bilateral symmetry, no standard tailoring assumptions.
physical_description.fit: Completely adjustable and non-conformist. The wrap-vest cinches at custom anchor points rather than standard seams. Leg wraps band and conform to any joint geometry. The asymmetric drape top eschews armholes entirely, allowing maximum freedom for non-standard limb ratios and torso configurations. Compression where needed, loose where freedom is required.
physical_description.primary_material: Raw-edge indigo canvas (wrap-vest), dark olive stretch-tech with adaptive fiber (leg wraps), natural-dye rust linen-analog (drape top). All materials engineered for durability and adjustability rather than conventional tailoring.
physical_description.texture: Raw, unfinished canvas with visible weave and exposed copper stitching. Stretch-tech has subtle ribbed response surface for grip and articulation. Linen-analog is slightly nubbed, organic-feeling but synthetic, with visible dye variation suggesting hand-treatment.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep indigo canvas with raw copper-bright stitching. Dark olive leg wraps. Rust-ochre asymmetric top. Palette suggests both utilitarian street culture and intentional aesthetic defiance.
physical_description.closures: Custom anchor-point magnetic snaps and friction-fit toggles on wrap-vest (non-standard placement). Adjustable tension cords on leg wraps. Open-toe sandals use adaptive tension-cord fastening. No zippers—all closures designed for rapid reconfiguration.
distinctive_features: Modular wrap-vest with exposed copper stitching and raw edge finishing
Leg wraps instead of trousers—banded panels that conform to non-human joint angles
Open-shoulder asymmetric drape top with no armhole constraints
Custom anchor points replacing standard seam placement
Open-toe wrap sandals with adjustable tension geometry
All closures designed for rapid reconfiguration and multi-body compatibility
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 5 street collective design—purpose-built for synthetic inhabitants of ungoverned zones. No luxury markers, no corpo branding. Radical functionality and anti-conformist aesthetic.
physical_description.cultural_context: Signals synthetic or heavily augmented identity, street collective affiliation (Orison), deliberate rejection of human-normative fashion standards, and existence outside standard corpo-tier social structures. Wearer is post-human or synthetically embodied.
physical_description.condition_typical: Raw and intentionally unfinished—this is the 'pristine' state. Expected to accumulate wear gracefully. Patching and modification are design features, not damage. Street-lived-in appearance is the goal.

image_prompt: Cyberpunk fashion photography of an impossibly tall synthetic humanoid model with elongated limbs wearing the Orison Synthform Adaptive Street Full Kit: raw indigo canvas wrap-vest with exposed copper stitching, dark olive adaptive leg wraps conforming to non-standard joints, rust-colored asymmetric drape top with bare shoulder, open-toe tension-cord sandals. The model's proportions are deliberately non-human—too-long arms, angled joints. Moody neon-shadow lighting against a rain-slicked GLMZ alleyway backdrop, industrial grate beneath feet.
